subject: executor: fix correctness of hash join v2 when there are multiple var-length keys (#55080)
summary: Reviewed the diff and the minimal key-path callers: `pkg/executor/join/join_row_table.go:newTableMeta`, probe matching via `pkg/executor/join/base_join_probe.go:isKeyMatched`, and `pkg/util/codec/codec.go:SerializeKeys`. The change replaces the old “keep string length only when inlined” rule with `KeepVarColumnLength` for all var-length key parts, dropping it only for the safe case of exactly one var-length key when keys are not inlined. This makes composite var-length join key serialization injective, preventing false-positive `bytes.Equal` matches during hash join v2 probing while keeping row layout/key-length handling consistent. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: subsequent edits in the same area are optimizations/space reductions (e.g. switching element-length prefixes to `uint32` in #57458), with no follow-up correctness fix indicating a lingering High/Blocker bug in this commit.
